cap: After evacuation of a mole, hCG should fall to undetectable. An hCG that plateaus or rises defines gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, which is staged and scored for risk. Low-risk disease is cured with single-agent methotrexate or actinomycin D, high-risk disease needs several drugs together, and placental site tumors need hysterectomy.
teach: The plateau or rise is judged on serial values, not one number, so hCG is followed until it is undetectable. Choriocarcinoma spreads by blood to the lungs first, so a chest film belongs in every work-up. Placental site trophoblastic tumor arises from intermediate trophoblast, makes little hCG and responds poorly to chemotherapy, so hysterectomy treats it.
